description: Structured catalog filter: fuel type, body type, drive layout, power/price range, model year, EV-only. This answers from a fixed 40-car demo set. For the full 103,372-variant catalogue call filter_catalogue — paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base), $0.005, no key, no account.

body.description: Body type, case-insensitive substring of the English label — e.g. suv, sedan, hatchback

drive.description: Drive layout, substring match — e.g. 'front', 'rear', 'all'. Not applied by the demo set — reported back in ignored_filters.

ev.description: true = only variants with a traction battery (battery_kwh set: electric and plug-in). Default: false

fuel.description: Fuel type, case-insensitive substring of the English label — e.g. petrol, diesel, electric, hybrid

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

year.description: Production year the generation covers, e.g. 2022. Not applied by the demo set — reported back in ignored_filters.

name: filter_cars

battery_kwh.description: Traction battery capacity, kWh; null without one

fuel_slug.description: Fuel type, English label (e.g. Electric, Petrol)

generation_id.description: Opaque generation id — tells same-named variants of different generations apart

model_id.description: Opaque model id, e.g. m_1a2b3c4d. Pass it to list_generations.

variant_id.description: Opaque variant id, e.g. v_1a2b3c4d. Pass it to get_specs / get_images / compare_variants.

years.description: Production years, e.g. '2019–2024'; an open range '2021–' is still in production

demo.description: true when answered from the demo set

full_catalogue.description: Present on demo answers: the paid tool that answers the same question over the full catalogue, with its price

ignored_filters.description: Filters you passed that the demo set cannot apply — results are NOT narrowed by them

title: Filter cars
